tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Every surface sits on it by default.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Panels, hover rows, photo placeholder and quiet blocks on ground. Never as text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections on ground and tint. Decorative only; controls use primary for their border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on ground and tint. Focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, dates and captions on ground and tint.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: links, buttons, active states, big blocks on ground. Text on ground and tint.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and marks on primary and primary-deep fills.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage name only. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: i build systems that let a small team run at scale.
styles.usage: Running text, 65 characters wide at most.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: a short note under a title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, tags, dates. Like every style, set in semi mono (MONO axis at 50).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; icon and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; padding inside buttons and tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid unit. Gap between rows and blocks; the cover pitch.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every control, panel, image and tag. There is no other radius.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Button and input outlines in primary; nav underline.
